Drop edge marks to an undirected graph

Source: R/transform.R
skeleton.Rd

Returns the skeleton of cg: the undirected graph obtained by replacing every directed or partially-directed edge with an undirected edge (a node pair keeps a single edge regardless of how many marked edges connected it).

Usage

skeleton(cg)

Arguments

cg

A DAG or PDAG-family (PDAG, CPDAG, MPDAG) graph created with cgraph().

Value

A UG graph proxy.

Examples

if (julia_ready()) {
  dag <- cgraph(A %-->% B, B %-->% C)
  skeleton(dag)
}
#> UG with 3 nodes and 2 edges:
#>   nodes: A, B, C
#>   edges:
#>     A --- B, B --- C
